name: Taiwan Mask Corporation
summary: Taiwan Mask Corporation engages in the design, development, production, and sale of photomasks and integrated circuits for the semiconductor industry. The company also provides technology assistance, consultation, inspection, and maintenance services for masks and circuits; foundry services to semiconductor design companies; and packaging and testing services. In addition, it manufactures and sells medical wares. The company has operations in Taiwan, Asia, the Americas, and internationally. Taiwan Mask Corporation was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan.
